```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(DT)

theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))
```

# Overview

MAGIC (Markov Affinity-based Graph Imputation of Cells) smooths single-cell
expression data by diffusing signals across a cell–cell affinity graph built
from the transcriptome neighbourhood. Because scRNA-seq data are extremely
sparse, many biologically relevant co-expression patterns are masked by
dropout. MAGIC recovers these patterns by sharing information between
transcriptionally similar cells.

**Key parameters used here**

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `t` | 3 | Diffusion steps (higher = more smoothing) |
| `knn` | 5 | Neighbours for affinity graph |
| Gene set | 2,000 HVGs | Highly variable genes from SCTransform |
| Input data | SCT `data` layer | Log-normalised, scaled counts |

> **Reference:** van Dijk et al., *Cell* 2018. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2018.05.061>

---

```{r load}
#| cache: false
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
targets::tar_load(magic_hsc)

# UMAP coordinates from processed object
umap_df <- as.data.frame(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
umap_df$cell_id <- rownames(umap_df)

# Cluster and condition metadata
clus_col <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.9$",
                 colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
meta_df <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::select(cell_id, sample.name, dm2_class,
                cluster = dplyr::all_of(clus_col)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("WT",     sample.name) ~ "WT",
      grepl("mCh-",  sample.name) ~ "mCh-",
      grepl("mCh\\+",sample.name) ~ "mCh+",
      TRUE ~ sample.name
    )
  )

umap_meta <- dplyr::left_join(umap_df, meta_df, by = "cell_id")

rm(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc); invisible(gc())

cat("Cells:", nrow(magic_hsc$raw),
    "| HVGs:", ncol(magic_hsc$raw),
    "| Glis1 present:", "Glis1" %in% colnames(magic_hsc$raw), "\n")
```

# 1  Sparsity before and after MAGIC

```{r sparsity-stats}
n_cells <- nrow(magic_hsc$raw)
n_genes <- ncol(magic_hsc$raw)

pct_zero_raw   <- mean(magic_hsc$raw   == 0) * 100
pct_zero_magic <- mean(magic_hsc$magic == 0) * 100

tibble::tibble(
  Metric  = c("Cells", "HVGs", "% zeros (raw)", "% zeros (MAGIC)"),
  Value   = c(
    formatC(n_cells, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    formatC(n_genes, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_zero_raw),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_zero_magic)
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lr")
```

```{r sparsity-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
#| fig-cap: "Left: distribution of per-gene % zero cells before and after MAGIC (2,000 HVGs). Right: distribution of per-cell mean expression before and after MAGIC."
gene_zero_raw   <- colMeans(magic_hsc$raw   == 0) * 100
gene_zero_magic <- colMeans(magic_hsc$magic == 0) * 100
cell_mean_raw   <- rowMeans(magic_hsc$raw)
cell_mean_magic <- rowMeans(magic_hsc$magic)

p1 <- tibble::tibble(
  pct   = c(gene_zero_raw, gene_zero_magic),
  layer = rep(c("Raw SCT", "MAGIC"), each = n_genes)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(pct, fill = layer, colour = layer)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  labs(x = "% zero cells per gene", y = "Density", fill = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p2 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean  = c(cell_mean_raw, cell_mean_magic),
  layer = rep(c("Raw SCT", "MAGIC"), each = n_cells)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(mean, fill = layer, colour = layer)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  labs(x = "Mean expression per cell", y = "Density", fill = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p1 | p2
```

# 2  Glis1 — raw vs MAGIC

*Glis1* (GLI-Similar 1) is a transcription factor expressed in primitive HSCs
and implicated in cellular reprogramming and maintenance of the
undifferentiated state. Because it is lowly expressed and therefore heavily
affected by dropout, it is an informative test case for imputation.

```{r glis1-setup}
gene <- "Glis1"
if (!gene %in% colnames(magic_hsc$raw)) {
  cat(gene, "is not in the HVG set — showing a representative HVG instead.\n")
  # Pick gene with similar sparsity to Glis1 for illustration
  gene <- names(sort(gene_zero_raw, decreasing = FALSE))[
    which.min(abs(sort(gene_zero_raw, decreasing = FALSE) - 90))[1]]
  cat("Using:", gene, "\n")
}

glis1_df <- umap_meta |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    raw   = as.numeric(magic_hsc$raw[cell_id,   gene]),
    magic = as.numeric(magic_hsc$magic[cell_id, gene])
  )
```

## 2.1  UMAP — raw vs MAGIC

```{r glis1-umap, fig.height=5, fig.width=11}
#| fig-cap: "UMAP coloured by Glis1 expression. Left: raw SCT (log-normalised). Right: MAGIC-imputed. Grey = zero / near-zero."

make_umap <- function(df, col, title, pal = "viridis") {
  df_plot <- df |> dplyr::arrange(.data[[col]])
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = pal, name = "expr") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right")
}

p_raw   <- make_umap(glis1_df, "raw",   paste0(gene, " — Raw SCT"))
p_magic <- make_umap(glis1_df, "magic", paste0(gene, " — MAGIC"))
p_raw | p_magic
```

## 2.2  Violin — expression by cluster

```{r glis1-violin, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
#| fig-cap: "Violin plots of Glis1 expression per cluster (res 0.9), before and after MAGIC."

glis1_long <- glis1_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(raw, magic), names_to = "layer", values_to = "expr") |>
  dplyr::mutate(layer = factor(layer, levels = c("raw", "magic"),
                               labels = c("Raw SCT", "MAGIC")))

ggplot(glis1_long, aes(cluster, expr, fill = layer)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(0.9),
               colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  facet_wrap(~layer, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Cluster (res 0.9)", y = "Expression",
       title = paste0(gene, " — raw vs MAGIC by cluster")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
```

## 2.3  Violin — expression by condition

```{r glis1-condition, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
#| fig-cap: "Glis1 expression by genotype condition, before and after MAGIC."

glis1_long |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, expr, fill = layer)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(0.9),
               colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Raw SCT" = "#d73027", "MAGIC" = "#4575b4")) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Expression",
       title = paste0(gene, " — raw vs MAGIC by condition"), fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## 2.4  Scatter — raw vs MAGIC per cell

```{r glis1-scatter, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot of raw vs MAGIC expression for Glis1 across all HSC cells. Colour = cluster."

ggplot(glis1_df, aes(raw, magic, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = paste0(gene, " raw SCT"),
       y = paste0(gene, " MAGIC"),
       colour = "Cluster") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# 3  Co-expression rescue — Glis1 × key HSC genes

A key motivation for MAGIC is recovering co-expression structure that is lost
to dropout. Here we compare scatter plots of *Glis1* against canonical HSC
markers before and after imputation.

```{r coexpr-setup}
partners <- c("Kit", "Slamf1", "Cd34", "Mpl", "Gata1", "Pf4")
partners <- intersect(partners, colnames(magic_hsc$raw))
cat("Co-expression partners found:", paste(partners, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r coexpr-scatter, fig.height=4, fig.width=14}
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plots of Glis1 vs key HSC/lineage markers. Each panel shows raw SCT (left, most points at zero) and MAGIC (right, continuous co-expression recovered)."
#| fig-height: !expr 4 * ceiling(length(partners) / 3)

plot_pair <- function(raw_g, magic_g, partner_r, partner_m, label) {
  df_r <- data.frame(x = raw_g,   y = partner_r, layer = "Raw SCT")
  df_m <- data.frame(x = magic_g, y = partner_m, layer = "MAGIC")
  df   <- rbind(df_r, df_m) |>
    dplyr::mutate(layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Raw SCT", "MAGIC")))

  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
                colour = "#d73027", linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~layer, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = gene, y = label) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
}

raw_g   <- magic_hsc$raw[,   gene]
magic_g <- magic_hsc$magic[, gene]

plots <- lapply(partners, function(g) {
  plot_pair(raw_g, magic_g, magic_hsc$raw[, g], magic_hsc$magic[, g], g)
})

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = min(3, length(plots)))
```

# 4  Global smoothing quality — top variable genes

```{r global-var, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=9}
#| fig-cap: "Gene-level variance before (x) vs after (y) MAGIC. Points above the diagonal gained variance (unexpected for smoothing — may reflect rescued structure). Points below lost variance (dropout noise removed). Colour = mean expression in raw data."

gene_var_raw   <- matrixStats::colVars(as.matrix(magic_hsc$raw))
gene_var_magic <- matrixStats::colVars(as.matrix(magic_hsc$magic))
gene_mean_raw  <- colMeans(magic_hsc$raw)

var_df <- data.frame(
  gene       = colnames(magic_hsc$raw),
  var_raw    = gene_var_raw,
  var_magic  = gene_var_magic,
  mean_raw   = gene_mean_raw
)

top_changed <- var_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(delta = var_magic - var_raw) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(abs(delta), n = 20) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene)

ggplot(var_df, aes(var_raw, var_magic, colour = log1p(mean_raw))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = var_df |> dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(gene, top_changed[1:10])),
    aes(label = gene), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20,
    colour = "black", box.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "log1p\n(mean)") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Variance (raw SCT, log scale)",
       y = "Variance (MAGIC, log scale)",
       title = "Gene-level variance: raw vs MAGIC") +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "bl", size = 0.3)
```

# 5  Heatmap — top Glis1-correlated genes (MAGIC)

After imputation, gene–gene correlations become interpretable. Here we show
the top genes most strongly correlated with *Glis1* in the MAGIC space and
visualise their MAGIC expression as a heatmap.

```{r glis1-corr-genes}
#| fig-cap: "Top 30 genes most correlated with Glis1 in MAGIC space."

if (gene %in% colnames(magic_hsc$magic)) {
  # Compute correlations of all HVGs with Glis1 (Pearson on MAGIC values)
  glis1_vec <- magic_hsc$magic[, gene]
  cors <- cor(glis1_vec, magic_hsc$magic, method = "pearson")[1, ]
  cors <- sort(cors, decreasing = TRUE)
  top_corr_genes <- names(cors)[2:31]  # skip self (rank 1)

  corr_df <- data.frame(
    gene = top_corr_genes,
    r    = cors[top_corr_genes]
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(r))

  corr_df_display <- corr_df
  corr_df_display$r <- round(corr_df_display$r, 3)
  DT::datatable(
    corr_df_display,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption  = paste0("Top 30 genes correlated with ", gene, " (MAGIC Pearson r)."),
    options  = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE)
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle("r",
      background = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#4575b4"),
      backgroundSize = "90% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
      backgroundPosition = "center")
} else {
  cat(gene, "not in MAGIC output.\n")
}
```

```{r glis1-corr-heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of MAGIC expression for top 30 genes correlated with Glis1 (columns = genes, rows = cells sampled by cluster, ordered by Glis1 MAGIC within each cluster)."

if (gene %in% colnames(magic_hsc$magic) && exists("top_corr_genes")) {
  show_genes <- c(gene, top_corr_genes)
  show_genes <- intersect(show_genes, colnames(magic_hsc$magic))

  # Sample ≤200 cells per cluster, ordered by Glis1 MAGIC within each cluster
  set.seed(42)
  cell_order <- umap_meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(glis1_magic = glis1_df$magic[match(cell_id, glis1_df$cell_id)]) |>
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
    dplyr::slice_sample(n = 200) |>
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, glis1_magic) |>
    dplyr::pull(cell_id)

  hm_mat <- t(magic_hsc$magic[cell_order, show_genes])

  # Row-scale for visibility
  hm_scaled <- t(scale(t(hm_mat)))
  hm_scaled[hm_scaled >  3] <-  3
  hm_scaled[hm_scaled < -3] <- -3

  cluster_anno <- umap_meta$cluster[match(cell_order, umap_meta$cell_id)]
  n_cl  <- length(unique(cluster_anno))
  cl_pal <- setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(n_cl),
    sort(unique(as.character(cluster_anno)))
  )

  top_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    cluster   = cluster_anno,
    col       = list(cluster = cl_pal),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    hm_scaled,
    col                  = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3),
                             c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027")),
    name                 = "scaled\nexpr",
    top_annotation       = top_anno,
    cluster_rows         = TRUE,
    cluster_columns      = FALSE,
    show_column_names    = FALSE,
    row_names_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
    row_names_side       = "left",
    column_title         = paste0("Top genes correlated with ", gene, " (MAGIC, sampled cells)"),
    column_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    use_raster           = TRUE,
    raster_quality       = 3
  )
}
```

---

# Methods

**MAGIC algorithm.** MAGIC builds a cell–cell affinity graph using the $k$
nearest neighbours in gene-expression space ($k$ = `r 5`). Affinity weights
are computed from the $\ell_2$ distance via a Gaussian kernel with
bandwidth chosen per cell. The resulting stochastic (row-normalised) affinity
matrix is raised to the power $t$ = `r 3` (diffusion steps) and used to
smooth each gene's expression vector across the neighbourhood. Higher $t$
increases the radius of information sharing; the optimal $t$ can be chosen by
the knee of the MAGIC optimal transport distance curve.

**Input data.** The SCT `data` layer (Pearson residuals normalised by
Seurat's `SCTransform`) was used as input rather than raw counts, providing a
variance-stabilised, approximately log-normal starting point.

**Implementation.** Rmagic R package (KrishnaswamyLab/MAGIC, CRAN/GitHub)
calling the `magic-impute` Python backend via `reticulate`. Computation
performed on the top 2,000 highly variable genes selected by SCTransform.
